tara: heads up — onboarding ceres-6b int4 onto dedicated pool. default bundle (batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=256). hitting OOMs when 5-6 concurrent requests spike. also saw ~1.5x token-latency vs fp16 on short 32-token prompts. logs below.

jamie: can you paste the OOM stack or alloc log?

tara: sure — truncated:
```
2025-07-01T14:12:03Z ERROR oom: alloc failed: 1.2G requested while only 900M free
model=ceres-6b quant=int4 kv_cache=on max_new_tokens=256 batch=8
stack: runtime/alloc -> runtime/kv_prefetch -> runtime/batching
```

lee: two suspects: int4 memory packing + kv prefetching with long ctx + large max_new_tokens. try disabling kv_prefetch or reduce max_new_tokens to 128 as a quick mitigation.

mike: also try lowering batch_size to 4 and enable compact-on-alloc patch i pushed in canary yesterday (runtimes/compact: rev d3f2). that patch reclaims fragmentation after big allocations.

tara: @mike thanks — can you open a canary for compact-on-alloc? i'll run A/B with batch=4,max_new_tokens=128, kv_prefetch=off vs baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: compact-on-alloc rev d3f2 -> eng-ml-canary-03. Start: 2025-07-01 15:00 UTC. Link: https://deploys.internal/canary/eng-ml-canary-03

rhys: one more thing: we noticed quality regression on int4 for code completion on small contexts. can you run the micro-eval for codebench (100 cases) and compare exact-match vs fp16? If regression >3% we should consider hybrid quant (kv int8, weights int4) for ceres-6b.

tara: running micro-eval now, will post results. for mitigation plan I propose defaults: batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=128, kv_prefetch=false for dedicated; add compact-on-alloc to canary. If micro-eval looks ok we'll roll to canary and then promote.

jamie: sounds good. tag me on the eval output. :thumbsup:
